definition: The selected Dark Horse Manga English hardcover: Berserk Deluxe Volume 1, ISBN 9781506711980, published 26 March 2019, 696 pages, collecting Berserk volumes 1–3.

canonical_term: English translation in original Japanese right-to-left format
definition: Dark Horse describes its Berserk release as an English translation presented in the original Japanese right-to-left format.
cultural_caution: Reading direction and translation status do not prove equivalence of dialogue, sound effects, typography, pagination, cultural nuance, or any unverified individual translator credit. Japanese editions and other localizations remain separate textual witnesses.

supports: Dark Horse's English-translation and original Japanese right-to-left format description.

definition: The selected 2019 English collection is credited to Kentaro Miura; Dark Horse identifies Berserk as created by him.
cultural_caution: Creator attribution is not a character node or narrative authority to infer unquoted plot claims. This selected early collection must not be conflated with material credited differently after Miura's death.

supports: Dark Horse identifies Kentaro Miura as Berserk's creator and discusses his death.
The selected English collection's Kentaro Miura credit.

canonical_term: post-Miura Studio Gaga / Kouji Mori continuation boundary
original_script: 原作・三浦建太郎　漫画・スタジオ我画　監修・森恒二
transliteration: Gensaku: Miura Kentarō; manga: Studio Gaga; kanshū: Mori Kōji
literal_gloss: Original work: Kentaro Miura; manga: Studio Gaga; supervision: Kouji Mori
definition: Hakusensha's 2022 resumption notice assigns the continuation credit to Kentaro Miura for original work, Studio Gaga for manga, and Kouji Mori for supervision.
cultural_caution: This later production/credit arrangement is a hard chronology and authorship boundary. It does not supply retrospective evidence for the selected English volumes 1–3 or license cross-era plot/character inferences.

citations.locator: 『ベルセルク』再開のお知らせ, 7 June 2022; continuation credit
supports: Hakusensha's stated continuation credit after resumption.

definition: Dark Horse presents Berserk as adult/mature manga and characterizes it as violent and horrifying, advising that it is not for the squeamish or easily offended.
cultural_caution: The selected edition can involve extreme graphic violence, sexual violence/abuse themes, body horror, coercion, torture, death, and trauma. This term is a content-access caution, not an attempt to sensationalize, normalize, or reproduce harmful material.

supports: Dark Horse's mature, violent, horrifying, and reader-discretion framing.

definition: Dark Horse describes Berserk as a source for internationally popular anime and separately markets a 2018 Official Guidebook covering the first 38 volumes.
cultural_caution: Anime, films, games, and the guidebook are separate media/reference witnesses. None can establish character attributes, chronology, dialogue, or events for the selected English Deluxe Volume 1 without an exact primary-volume locator.

supports: Dark Horse identifies the manga as the wellspring for anime adaptations.

citations.locator: Official Guidebook description and publication details
supports: The guidebook's distinct 2018 product identity and first-38-volume scope.
